meta.title: What Is a Non-Registered Account? Taxable Investing in Canada, Explained – The Long Math
meta.description: A non-registered account is a taxable investment account with no contribution limits and no special tax shelter. Here's how interest, dividends, and capital gains are each taxed — and what usually belongs in one.
